body:
I can reproduce the reported behaviour (Windows 11, 4.4.1-stable), either by pulling my Ethernet cable or disconnecting from WiFi.

There seems to be a timeout mechanism, because if I send a packet the state eventually changes to 3. I didn't time it exactly, but it seems to be around 20 seconds. Without sending anything, it stays in state 1 indefinitely.

Also, if you set `socket.heartbeat_interval = 1.0` the state will change quickly.

There might be a way to detect this particular kind of loss of connection without relying on a heartbeat/timeout, but I'm not sure -- there will always be some cases where it's definitely not possible, like network outages beyond the local computer.

I created an MRP to help with further testing, it connects to the endpoint provided by https://websocket.org/tools/websocket-echo-server: 

[websocket-disconnected.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19765053/websocket-disconnected.zip)

@AThousandShips
